records.issue_text: apps/web/components/dialog/AddGuestsDialog.tsx:43 — Interpolating an optional error code always creates a truthy string, so the unable-to-add fallback can never be shown.

records.rationale: The new file packages/ui/form/MultiEmail.tsx line 2 does import `{ Button, EmailField, Icon, Tooltip } from "@calcom/ui"`, and this diff adds `export { default as MultiEmail } from "./form/MultiEmailLazy"` to packages/ui/index.tsx, so a genuine cycle exists: ui barrel → MultiEmailLazy → MultiEmail → ui barrel. It's a concrete, diff-specific architectural/coupling concern; whether it causes a runtime initialization failure is unverifiable from the diff (many bundlers tolerate such cycles), so it is not established as a defect.
